Acknowledgments –

From we wish to express our sincere gratitude to all the individuals and organizations that made the creation of this Valencia audio guide possible. This project is the result of collective effort, shared enthusiasm, and the deep commitment of those who contributed their time, knowledge, and care to bring this sound experience to life.

Our special thanks go to our families and friends. Thank you for your endless patience, for understanding the time required, and for always being there with words of encouragement and silent gestures that gave us strength. Your passion, constant support, and faith in this dream have been essential to making it a reality. This achievement is also yours.

We also appreciate the collaboration of historians, local guides, and cultural experts, whose insights enriched the content with rigor and sensitivity. Likewise, we thank the technical and creative team who shaped every detail with professionalism and enthusiasm.

Our gratitude extends to cultural institutions and local stakeholders who, directly or indirectly, supported this project by providing access to resources, spaces, and information, and by promoting the dissemination of Valencia's heritage with an open and committed perspective.

We also thank the neighborhood associations, businesses, and individuals who generously shared their stories, experiences, and perspectives on the city. And, of course, those who participated in the preliminary listening tests, providing key suggestions to improve the final experience.

Finally, our thanks go to the team for their dedication, creativity, and constant commitment. This audio guide reflects a shared dream that we are proud and grateful to offer to everyone wishing to discover Valencia with fresh eyes —and new ears.
